title: Breadcrumb Navigation Mechanism
description: Introduce a framework-level navigation-tree model (breadcrumb decoupled from URL and VFS) whose separators dynamically suggest alternatives. Wire sketchpad with Home > Kits > {Kit} > Typologies > {Typology} > Designs > {Design}.
summary: Replaced Platform.breadcrumb with NavigationDestination, NavigationLevel, and Platform.navigation in framework/core. Platform renderer maps navigation trails to Breadcrumb options via navigationTrailToBreadcrumbItems. Sketchpad implements sketchpadNavigation with typology-aware trails and home/docs/feedback alternatives. Tests: navigationTrailToBreadcrumbItems (platform renderer, 22 pass); Sketchpad navigation (1 pass).
